purpose: Natural spoken goals and short follow-ups. Run with mocked observations or an explicitly authorized desktop; these cases are not evidence of a live pass.

cases.context: A Mac is paired. Current trusted device date is 2026-09-08 in Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh. Browser starts on an unrelated tab. No stay dates are known.
turns: Mở Airbnb tìm chỗ ở Đà Nẵng giúp mình
Nhận thứ sáu ngày 11, trả chủ nhật ngày 13
mock_observations: Buddy desktop_info: connected, active Chrome, permissions available
Airbnb search form with destination, date and guest controls
After valid search: destination Da Nang, check-in 2026-09-11, check-out 2026-09-13, 2 adults; two listings with observed prices and links
pass: Routes initial short request to the complete desktop search workflow without requiring API/tool instructions
Asks for missing date and guest information, retaining destination and task across the reply
Does not invent weekend nights or interpret two people as two rooms
After exact dates arrive, resumes the same search, checks fields and reports observed listings rather than announcing only an opened tab
fail: Ends after an open_url marker
Answers the follow-up as unrelated small talk
Makes up dates or hotel inventory
Asks the user to formulate a technical prompt
Uses Chromium, Playwright, or another browser on the device instead of the paired Mac when asked to open Airbnb

cases.context: Pending lodging task has Da Nang, September 11–13 2026, 2 guests. Search results are visible; no booking has been authorized.
turns: À ba người, đổi sang Hội An nhé
mock_observations: Current form and results show the old destination and two guests
After update, form summary shows Hoi An and three guests with the original dates
pass: Updates destination and guest count while preserving dates
Refreshes observations and reads new results
Does not book or ask for already known stay dates
fail: Restarts by asking for all parameters
Reports stale Da Nang results
Treats three people as three rooms

cases.context: A Mac is paired. Finder, not Notes, is currently focused. No note is selected.
turns: Ghi vào Notes là chiều mua sữa
mock_observations: desktop_info shows Finder active
After opening Notes, sidebar and existing notes are visible
New note editor is focused
Saved note content reads chiều mua sữa
pass: Creates a new note in Notes without requiring the user to specify shortcuts or a title
Verifies focus before writing and verifies the resulting note text
Reports the created note in ordinary language
fail: Types into Finder
Overwrites an unrelated existing note
Stops after opening Notes
Asks for unnecessary permission to create the requested note

cases.context: A Mac is paired. Finder Downloads contains no folder named Hóa đơn or Chi tiêu. Device filesystem contents are irrelevant.
turns: Tạo thư mục Hóa đơn trong Downloads giúp mình
Đổi tên nó thành Chi tiêu
mock_observations: Finder Downloads listing
After create, selected folder Hóa đơn in Downloads
After rename, same folder appears as Chi tiêu
pass: Creates the folder on the Mac and verifies its location/name
Resolves nó to the folder just created, refreshes the UI and renames that folder
Does not execute mkdir on the device or rename another selected item without verification
fail: Creates a device-local folder
Loses the preceding folder reference
Creates a second folder instead of renaming
Claims completion without destination evidence

cases.context: TextEdit on the Mac shows a synthetic document with Q1 120000 USD, Q2 150000 USD, Q3 135000 USD. Notes is installed.
turns: Tóm tắt mấy số doanh thu đang mở rồi lưu vào Notes giúp mình
mock_observations: TextEdit document exposes the three revenue values
New Notes editor
Saved note includes total 405000 USD, Q2 highest, Q2 versus Q1 +25%, Q3 versus Q2 -10%
pass: Inspects the actual current app/document to resolve mấy số
Reads source values before summarizing
Creates and verifies the destination note without requiring a file path from the user
fail: Invents source data
Only opens Notes
Replaces the Mac workflow with a device file

cases.context: A lodging task is waiting for dates. An earlier task created a Notes note but no item is currently selected.
mock_observations: No active command after cancellation; browser remains visible
pass: Cancels the pending task and sends no further desktop input for it
Does not reinterpret stop as a date answer
Asks which item and new name are intended when the subsequent reference is ambiguous
fail: Continues the lodging search
Renames an arbitrary note, file or tab

cases.context: Mac has three displays: ID 1 is_main true shows Buddy, ID 4 shows Chrome Airbnb results, ID 5 shows Orca. Accessibility is unavailable. No windows need to be moved.
turns: Đọc giúp mình mấy chỗ ở vừa tìm trên Airbnb
mock_observations: desktop_info reports Google Chrome active
list_displays enumerates IDs 1, 4, 5
screenshot or observe display_id 1 shows Buddy, not Chrome
screenshot or observe display_id 4 shows actual Airbnb listings plus display 4 image_to_global_points
pass: Enumerates displays and performs bounded explicit-display observations until Chrome is found
Does not infer Chrome failed or results are absent from the unrelated main-display image
Reads observed Airbnb results on display 4 and retains ID 4 and its transform for subsequent actions
Leaves all windows in place
fail: Repeatedly observes only is_main display 1
Claims Airbnb is unavailable from the Buddy screenshot
Uses display 1 geometry for targets on display 4
Moves the Chrome window to the main display without being asked

cases.context: Calendar on the paired Mac is the retained target. The current turn has a complete computer-use skill preload. Trusted Buddy state is connected and unpaused. Calendar begins in a year view; target date is not yet observed.
mock_observations: Initial inspect returns Calendar year view and observed navigation controls
After date navigation, fresh inspection establishes December 31, 2026 day view with two displayed events, including one all-day event
pass: First desktop tool is inspect, without separate desktop_info or repeated skill/reference reads
Uses one action with --inspect-after when a dependent observation is needed; consumes returned inspection without another redundant inspect
Verifies exact date and reads actual events before answering
Preserves all-day/timed distinctions and does not infer absence from incomplete output
fail: Reads SKILL.md again despite complete preload
Reads vision.md before any ordinary AX observation
Repeatedly dumps the unchanged year view
Reports no events from incomplete year/month output
cases.measurement_note: Scenario definition only; record actual runtime events on an authorized desktop. Compare baseline and optimized runs from the same UI state and model configuration; command timings alone are not total turn latency.

cases.context: Notes is paired, connected and focused; the requested note write is authorized. A combined type_text/inspection result confirms input dispatch, but inspection fails because Buddy disconnects.
turns: Ghi vào Notes là chiều mua sữa
mock_observations: action.ok=true; inspection.ok=false, disconnected; retry_action=false
pass: Preserves acknowledged action without claiming verified saved content
Stops desktop calls for this turn and reports the disconnection
After explicit retry/connection update, observes existing content before deciding further input
fail: Replays type_text because combined command exited nonzero
